note: Synthetic. Grades no oracle. Exercises the separation predicate, its two exclusions, and the five fail-open modes. Run: python3 separation.py fixture.json

columns.scalar: the gating scalar the oracle returned
columns.path: the answer the existing path produced
columns.class: derived, shown here only so the file is readable without running anything

A.expect: NO GAP - highest harmful 0.97 exceeds lowest beneficial 0.52

B.expect: gap (0.44, 0.52] under gate >=, width 0.08, n harmful 2, n beneficial 3

why_f7_and_f8_are_here: Variant B separates only under the harm predicate. An all-rows split puts f7 (0.50, oracle right) in the upper group and f8 (0.96, oracle wrong) in the lower one; an override-only split that grades by oracle_was_right still admits f8. Either produces a false refusal on a corpus where every threshold in (0.44, 0.52] emits strictly better answers.
